hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in the intensive care unit following acute abdominal obstruction during his prison term. Tensions have mounted as Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the temporary removal of his electronic ankle monitor during treatment, triggering fierce commentary from political supporters and family members who attribute his declining health to his incarceration.
hotspots.affect: The life-threatening health emergency of a right-wing icon inside custody mobilizes intense grief, martyrdom narratives, and bitter legal contention.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: In the final stretch before the November 29 general election, Vox has amplified its campaign messaging around strict border control, immediate deportation of illegal migrants, and suspending trade agreements with Morocco. The party is engaged in sharp clashes with the mainstream Popular Party (PP) over voting tactics while polls indicate Vox could prove decisive for a right-wing majority.
hotspots.affect: Campaign urgency mixed with aggressive anti-immigrant rhetoric drives intense polarized heat ahead of a critical electoral deadline.

hotspots.title: AfD Escalates Deportation Demands at Party Congresses
hotspots.blurb: AfD co-leader Tino Chrupalla sparked widespread outcry after asserting plans to deport up to 2.6 million foreign nationals, setting a radical tone at party congresses in North Rhine-Westphalia and Hamburg. The party's explicit stance has triggered severe warnings from anti-semitism monitors and prompted substantial counter-protests outside convention halls.
hotspots.affect: Extremely high deportation figures push the boundaries of public discourse, drawing furious condemnation from opposition groups and legal experts.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: Scandal continues to engulf Rassemblement National following revelations that sensitive internal security emails from Prefect Hugues Moutouh were discovered during searches of Marine Le Pen's close associate. Prefect Moutouh has requested to be relieved of his duties as judicial investigations broaden into alleged state leaks benefiting the far-right party.
hotspots.affect: Allegations of state intelligence leaks into a top political party generate heavy coverage around law enforcement neutrality and institutional corruption.

hotspots.title: Milei Triumphs as Tesla Launches in Argentina
hotspots.blurb: Javier Milei celebrated the arrival of Tesla in Argentina as a landmark victory for his deregulation and free-market agenda. However, the economic triumph occurs against a backdrop of market turbulence, rising sovereign borrowing costs, and internal political battles over primary election rules and cabinet alignment.
hotspots.affect: Triumphant messaging around high-profile foreign investment clashes with underlying economic anxieties and fierce internal coalition battles.
